title: Global Military Expenditure and the Changing Security Landscape
discussion_signal: The relay places the 2025 spending increase in a longer trend of rising military expenditure, highlighting divergent U.S., Chinese, Russian, European, and Ukrainian trajectories and the concentration of global spending among major powers and NATO members.
linked_research_question: How do long-run military-resource shifts and alliance concentration interact with geopolitical tension without making spending alone a proxy for strategic control?
limits: The post is a secondary summary of SIPRI data
Spending trends do not alone establish strategic effectiveness
